description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the EmployeeAttachmentDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests functionalities such as saving, retrieving, and deleting employee attachments, including edge cases with invalid inputs and multiple attachment screens.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeAttachmentDao, verifying CRUD operations, input validation, and edge cases for employee attachments in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, instantiates the DAO, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee attachment and verifies it is stored correctly.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentForFreshEmployee
methods.description: Tests saving an attachment for a newly added employee.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentWithId
methods.description: Tests saving an attachment with a predefined ID.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachmentWithInvalidScreen
methods.description: Verifies that setting an invalid screen value raises an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for an employee across different screens and verifies counts.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee attachment by employee and attachment IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachmentWithoutScreen
methods.description: Tests retrieving an attachment without specifying screen, expecting specific default behavior.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple attachments and confirms deletion.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachmentsWithWrongIdForScreen
methods.description: Verifies deletion behavior when attachment IDs do not match the specified screen.
